Components and links as a list

Components

  • On the Orange Pi 5 Plus
    • FAST-LIO2: LiDAR-inertial odometry
    • KISS-SLAM: 2D occupancy map
    • Frontier detector: picks the next goal
    • Supervisor: 10-state mission
    • Nav2: 3 of 4 costmap plugins
    • Geofence: slow, then stop zones
    • Rover bridge: UDP to the rover server
  • On the Jetson Xavier NX
    • YOLO + ArUco: cubes and placards
  • On the rover's Raspberry Pi
    • Rover server: velocity gate
  • Hardware and the browser
    • Livox MID-360: LiDAR + IMU
    • 3 of 5 IP cameras: centre, left, right (RTSP)
    • Picos: drive, arm, excavator
    • Theseus GCS page: operator's browser

Links

  • Livox MID-360 to FAST-LIO2: points, IMU
  • FAST-LIO2 to KISS-SLAM: scans
  • KISS-SLAM to Frontier detector: map
  • Frontier detector to Supervisor: frontiers
  • Supervisor to Nav2: goals
  • Nav2 to Geofence: velocity
  • Geofence to Rover bridge: velocity
  • Rover bridge to Rover server: velocity, state
  • Rover server to Rover bridge: arena, enable
  • Rover server to Picos: USB serial
  • Theseus GCS page to Rover server: WebSocket
  • 3 of 5 IP cameras to YOLO + ArUco: video
  • YOLO + ArUco to Supervisor: cubes; placards, which did not reach the supervisor at ARCh 2026
  • YOLO + ArUco to Nav2: cubes
